source_specific_conventions.headings: Use # for 第21章, ## for each numbered 節, ### for numbered topics, and #### for definition/advantage/disadvantage or bounded subtopics. Preserve source section titles; do not flatten sections.
source_specific_conventions.locators: Physical page IDs T2:NNN are separate from printed labels ㉑-N; T2:007 has no printed label. Section citations may share a page only within this batch owner and must name the source region and destination heading.
source_specific_conventions.page_ownership: JPG-T2-C001 owns every included physical page T2:007-T2:030 exactly once; there are no excluded pages in this batch.
source_specific_conventions.content: Designated JPGs are authoritative. Preserve source terminology, definitions, conditions, exceptions, timing, numerical values, journal-entry relationships, tables and diagram meaning. PDF is identity/planning support only.
source_specific_conventions.tables_and_diagrams: Convert essential diagram relationships to faithful prose/tables while retaining direction, labels, comparisons and values; retain debit/credit/amount relationships as tables.
source_specific_conventions.format: Source Markdown contains no bold, Cloze, Front/Back, integration or card output. Only OCR/PDF spacing artifacts were normalized; no learner-content correction was required.
source_specific_conventions.question_layout: Not applicable: this theory pilot contains no question-to-answer pairs or false-proposition labels.

positive_preservation_examples: Definitions and conditions: T2:008, T2:009, T2:012, T2:024, T2:027 and T2:030.
Tables, formulas and journal entries: T2:010, T2:011, T2:013, T2:018, T2:019 and T2:028.
Numerical examples: 500/15/485, 100/150/250/300, 17,840/26,760, 100/80/120/96, 100/120/30 and weighted-average 105 were checked against the images.
negative_checks: No missing definition, condition, exception, procedure, formula, table row, diagram relationship, numerical value or journal-entry line was found across T2:007-T2:030.
No unresolved marker, invented content, unlabelled false proposition or out-of-batch locator remains.
No page is excluded or left without coverage; no source object crosses the T2:030 batch boundary.
